# VTA Star Browser Prototype

Status: prototype. Source inspection: 2026-09-08.

Unpacked browser prototype imports an appearance projection from City Key or journey JSON and retains only its validated palette in session storage. Its inspected README states that it cannot contact VTAs, exchange credentials or authenticate a City session.

Located prototype; do not equate it with the separate Star Key experiment or a working sign-on provider. Subsequent local update: explicit toolbar palette sharing into the Guide is implemented; no authenticated VTA presentation is established.
